## Objective

Deliver the shared Task billboard capability specified by TRD-20260926-5A1422F9 while preserving current execution authority and minimizing necessary verification.

User value: Assigned agents can exchange relevant information directly between formal handoffs without losing independent analysis, controlled decisions or time to excessive testing.

### Success outcomes

- All 62 original requirements have usable source/Task/pilot evidence with bounded direct collaboration and version-specific owner decisions.
- Task-local storage, visibility, native delivery and current decision gates pass the minimal necessary cases; aggregation follows controlled pilots.
- Reusable sources and neutral Template are complete, with only explicitly selected disposable adoption exercised and live projects preserved.
- One comparable baseline/enabled pair reports useful quality and communication cost honestly; unchanged passing evidence is reused.

## Scope

### In scope

- Versioned collaboration contract and separate reusable skill/helper.
- Immutable participant-owned messages/corrections/receipts, pre-exposure policy filtering, scoped reads, explicit acknowledgement, release-aware unread state and bounded delivery.
- Minimal current Task integration, source working habits, exact snapshots/material gates and proposals through existing knowledge/maintenance owners.
- Four focused deterministic bundles, two controlled task-local native pilots, later project aggregation, checked neutral Template and disposable new/existing adoption boundaries.
- One matched comparison baseline, reused enabled pilot and final bidirectional coverage/preservation audit.

### Out of scope

- Current-turn implementation, Task/TRD/goal mutation or lifecycle approval.
- Unrestricted group chat, competing approval/execution/knowledge/maintenance ledgers or new traffic-management roles.
- Databases, message brokers, continuous polling, unattended AI, dependency/service provisioning and Git-as-live-messaging.
- Automatic active-root/product/Aether-Flow adoption, registry changes, external messages, Git publication or deployment.
- Automatic post-to-memory/ontology publication, changed scientific claims or unsupported installed physics-role claims.
- Broad test suites, speculative stress/fuzz matrices, repeated unchanged checks or a benchmark campaign.

### Execution authority

This creation saves a planning baseline only. Creating, tracking or approving this plan does not itself authorize implementation, Task execution, installation, deletion, knowledge publication, product/root adoption, Git publication, deployment or another separately governed action.

### Constraints

- Planning only now; future execution requires approval of the exact plan revision and separately authorized execution through the applicable project workflow.
- Retain all 62 TRD outcomes and acceptance cases plus REQ-063 minimal verification; share evidence rather than delete mandatory criteria.
- Use Python 3.12 and the standard library; no database, broker, dependency installation or runtime service belongs to the initial capability.
- Every future role assignment uses a fresh filesystem-backed role catalog; retain exact model/effort, independent context, required team and actual capacity without synthetic native claims.
- Respect selected historical Task/orchestration versions and protected version 2 broker requirements. Prefer existing artifact/input events and preserve all size caps.
- Only source collections and explicitly checked neutral Template changes belong to reusable implementation. Current root/product adoption needs a separate exact manifest and grant.
- Store concise evidence and limits; posts and external-source claims do not grant authority, scientific status or knowledge publication.
- Run one stable focused test module and reuse native pilot results. Additional checks need a mandatory uncovered criterion, changed input or actual failure rationale.
